lines.en: And so the moment for me to decide how I’ll be spending my night has once again reared its ugly head — casting aside choice after choice when they all lead to the same place in the end.
Me. A girl. Some place where we can rest our bodies. Probably a leash if Chika is involved. Probably some light arguing if it’s Makoto. But no matter who it is, I know what I’ll be doing tonight.
And there is no one who can stop me.
: Hello?
: Hey. We’re hanging out tonight.
: This is the biggest plot twist I have ever experienced.
: What is? Me calling you? I’ve done that before.
: Never right after I speak to myself about how I’m going to wind up having sex with whatever girl I see tonight.
: Please don’t.
: Too late now, Osako. You’ve toyed with fate and must pay the price.
: Wow. I completely understand why you’re so popular with girls now. Who can compete with pickup lines like that?
: Osako, I’m so miserable.
: Wow. I completely understand why you’re so popular with girls now. Who can compete with emotional stability like that?
: You are one of the last people I want to hear about “emotional stability” from. And I know a lot of emotionally unstable people, Osako. A lot.
: Cool. So when are we meeting?
: I don’t know. What are we doing?
: Something I’m pretty sure no straight guy has ever done before.
: You?
: Yeah. Come have sex with me. I’ll send you the address now.
I tap on my- wait, no. My phone beeps. I look at it.
: You want me to go all the way to the urban district?
: Yup. That’s where I am going to have sex with you. I can’t wait.
: Ugh. You’re lucky I’m such a good friend.
: No, I’m lucky you’re such a perverted pushover. See you soon!
Osako hangs up the phone and I begin to make my way to the nearest subway station.
Then, after a brief ride along a line that was surprisingly busy for this time of night, I manage to catch up with her.
: Guess who’s ready to fuck a lesbian.
: Me. Pretty much all the time.
: You’re gonna have to find another one, though. I changed my mind right after I hung up on you.
: Not even the girls who like girls can be trusted. Where am I supposed to find another lesbian at this time of night?
: Right over there. Where we’re going.
: Oh god. Are you taking me to a gay bar? Do you have any idea how torturous that will be for a chronic heterosexual like me?
: Nope. Gayer.
: Than a gay bar?
: I said what I said and I stand by it.
: Osako...what are we doing?
: So! Remember that time I talked to you about needing new hobbies? And then you dragged me to a porn shop to join the MILF of the Month Club?
: I remember how much you loved it, yeah. Why continue the search when we’ve already found the perfect thing for you?
: Because there are a bunch of other things I want to try too! And it’s my turn to subject you to something you’re likely going to hate.  Which is why we’re taking a class on witchcraft tonight.
: We are not. I don’t do things like that.
: We sure are. And yes you do.
: I do not.
: Yes you do.
: I...do...not.
: Sure you do! You love it.
: No means no and that is final.
: I fucking hate you, Osako.
Somehow, Osako manages to drag me into a community college in the urban district that hosts a variety of silly and meaningless classes that I highly doubt anyone ever takes seriously.
: Now, before we begin, I just want to remind everyone that witchcraft is far more serious and powerful than you might initially believe. But only in the hands and minds of those who trust it.
I stand corrected and sad.

: Today, we’ll be learning about different types of spells that crystals can be used for, how to properly place them on altars and grids, and then a little bit of dowsing and energy healing for fun at the end!
: Okay. So maybe I was a little out of line with the MILF thing. But this is just low.
: Oh, come on! It’ll be fun. Especially near the end when we get to all the dowsing and energy healing.
: I don’t know what either of those two things mean, Osako.
: Me either! But that’s what makes it fun! Maybe.
: Excuse me! First and foremost, love the top. But second, would you and your hubby mind quieting down a teensy-weensy bit so I can proceed? Thankies!
: Yes. This man is my husband. And I will now demonstrate the power of women by making him shut up.
: Slay, queen.
: Never say that again. Do you understand?
: I’m sorry.
: I need to hear that you understand. I will not risk hearing this a second time. Acknowledge these words, beard.
: I think your crystal is making you mean. It must be misaligning your chakras or something. That’s a thing, right?
: Never say that again either. In fact, just stay quiet for the rest of class. Thankies.
: Since when do you even like this stuff? Witchcraft seems like more of a Wakana thing, doesn’t it?
: I don’t like this stuff. I know nothing about it. And while it definitely is more of a Wakana thing, that doesn’t mean I wouldn’t enjoy it.
: Besides, every lesbian needs to attempt witchcraft at least once or they revoke our license and we start liking men.
: So you’ve forced me to attend the funeral for the only chance I’d ever have with you. Reiko Kobayakawa would not be proud right now.
: Yeah. But on the bright side, look at all of these other lesbians you can take home to not have sex with.
: Can we just skip to the dowsing part now? My pride is so lost at this point that I’m probably going to need the assistance of magic to unearth it.
: Akira, there is no amount of dowsing that could help you recover what has never existed in the first place.
: That’s where the magic comes in.
: Woah! Sensei?
: Oh, Noriko and Kirin are here too.
: That makes sense.
: What are you doing here? And who’s your super hot friend?
: Miss Watabe’s girlfriend. Sort of.
: Wait, really?! I remember you looking kinda different! I suddenly don’t know who to be more jealous of between you and your partner.
: Uhh...thank you?
: Are you actually into this stuff, Noriko?

: I’m not not into it! I think this stuff can be kind of fun so long as you don’t buy too much into it. I’m just here because Kirin wanted to learn how to make a love potion and I wanted to be supportive.
: I do not! I just thought it would be funny! That love potion thing wasn’t serious at all!
: Ooooooh. Riiiiiiight. Gotcha.
: Don’t make your dismissal so obviously fake either! Be a better friend and support me in my efforts to...steal your future husband or whatever!
: I’m doing the best I can, Kirin. I-

: Ahem! Hi, new girls! Welcome to the class! Buuuuut, if it’s not a problem, could you also keep it down a tad? I already warned your friends, but this is not the kind of class you can just talk through.
: Gotcha. We’ll be good. We both love crystals. And sage. And dowsing.
: Ah! Well, you’re in luck then! First, though...are you sure you’re in the right place? Because this class is for adults only and-
: Oh, I signed up beforehand. Stacy Fakename. Eighteen. And this is my cousin, Joanna.
: Oh, great! I see both of you right here. Now, where were we?
: Ah, right! The identification of crystals is far more complex than merely memorizing their names and colors. Each one possesses certain qualities that-
: Hey, you guys don’t mind if we join you, right? The last time Kirin and I came to one of these things, women kept trying to hit on us.
: You’ll have to ask Osako. This is her thing. I’m just being dragged along for the very painful ride.
: Osako’s your name? Can I call you that? Or should I be more formal?
: It’s only one letter off from my family name, so it doesn’t make much of a difference either way.
: Cool! Osako it is then. I just didn’t want to be rude.
: Well...thanks. Are you always this polite?
: I think she just wants to fuck you.
: Yeah, I was thinking the same thing.
: Hahah! You guys are so funny!
: She didn’t deny it.
: She rarely ever does. It’s cool that you’re into this stuff though, Osako! Maybe you can give Kirin and I some tips on potioncraft?
: Oh, no. I’m not into it or anything. This is Witchcraft 101. I’m just...trying out a bunch of new hobbies and dragging who I can only assume is your teacher along with me to make him suffer.
: We’re good friends. It just doesn’t look like it.
: A little self-searching, then? Fun! Kirin’s doing the same thing right now.
: Maybe the two of us can find new hobbies...in each other.
: What does that even mean?
: What do you want it to mean?
: So is that love potion for me? Or-
: There is no potion, damn it! It was a joke!
: Another one for the harem, huh?
: You’ll fall for me too once they revoke your lesbian license. Which they may very well do at this rate since none of us have been paying attention to the class at all.
: I think I’ve got a little while left until they come for me. They normally wait until you hit thirty to start knocking on your door.
: I’m assuming you’re the same age as Wakana, then?
: Uh...yeah. But...you call her by her first name too? She hates when students do that.
: I’m an exception. Wakana and I are great friends. She was actually my teacher before Akira-sensei was.
: And you call...him by his first name?
: Of course. He’s my Onii-chan.
: You’re related?
: Only when my clothes are on! Once they’re off, I’m whatever he wants me to be! Which is totally fine since I’m Stacy Fakename! Eighteen.
: This harem thing really never ends, does it?
: Now do you see how hard my life is?
: The education system has failed us in so many ways, hasn’t it?
: You joke, but I imagine you’d be pretty popular with the girls in our school too, Osako.
: Me? No way. I don’t buy that at all.
: I guess she does kind of have that same sort of...Otoha thing going on for her, doesn’t she? Cool and princely aura, but still kind of feminine as a whole.
: Wakana, I’d understand. She’s cool. And super hot. But I’m just, like...Girl C.
: Girl C?
: Yeah. You know. Like...a background character. There’s nothing about me that really stands out.
: I mean...Wakana does have her own sort of...mini...harem...cult...thing. But I don’t think you’re “Girl C” at all, Osako.
: You have known me for ninety seconds.
: Yeah! Which was more than enough to make Kirin want to bang you.
: And I’ve only known her for ninety seconds, but I feel like that isn’t saying much.
: I’m hormonal, okay?! I’d cum from a fucking hug at this point in my life!
: Isn’t she just the cutest?
: Don’t compliment her too much or she might cum from that too.
: Aaaah! Fuck you guys! I’m going to the bathroom!
: Bye Kirin! Don’t cum!
: So is just...everyone in your school unhinged?
: Pretty much everyone except that Otoha girl that you were compared to a second ago, yeah.
: Great. So she’s Girl B and I’m Girl C. No harems here. Not like I’d know what to do with one anyway when I’ve only ever had eyes for one person.
: Really? I figured you’d have been really popular in school, Osako. Otoha definitely was at Kumon-mi Academy. It wasn’t until she was among all the misfits that she started fading into obscurity.
: I mean, like...I had friends. But I was active in sports clubs and stuff and...I don’t know. I wasn’t that type of popular.
: Hell, I didn’t even really start thinking about romance and stuff until college. Before that, Girl C would have been a compliment.
: You’ve just gotta wait for a spinoff then!
: Hm?
: It’s not unheard of for side characters to get spinoffs where they get to be the star! And that’s what you’re trying to figure out now by taking classes you’re not totally interested in, right?
: Uhh...I mean...I don’t know if I’d say I’m trying to become the main character. But feeling a little more like...someone who doesn’t solely exist for someone else would be nice.
: Well, you’ve picked the right person to accompany you on your journey then.
: This guy? You’re kidding.
: Would the two of you think less of me if I mentioned how that kind of hurt?
: See what I mean? You’re talking about Wakana, right? How she’s along for the journey? Because I’ve been trying to keep her out of it. I’m-
: No, I’m talking about Sensei.
: As weird as it is, he manages to bring out the best in people way more often than you’d think.
: No, I just think everyone else looks way better by comparison.
: What he said.
: Well, both of you have self-esteem issues then.
: Well, she’s got us there.
: Why are you holding my hand?
: Because I’m in love with you.
: What’s your name again? Stacy?
: Or Noriko. Either one works.
: Strong name.
: I’m a strong girl.
: And the man behind you is the one who helped turn me into that.
: Something tells me you’d have turned out just fine with or without him.
: Maybe. Maybe not. And maybe your whole self-discovery thing won’t really be influenced by him either.
: But I can tell from just these ninety...probably a hundred-twenty seconds now, that both of you can help each other.
: Well, I hope so. Because we both clearly need it.
: Misery is contagious. All we’re going to do is kill each other.
: I changed my mind. I love you again.
: Learn how to love me without touching me.
: Anyways! I’ll be right back. I’m gonna go make sure Kirin didn’t fall into the toilet and-
: Actually, don’t bother! Because all three of you are now being ejected from the class for disturbing everyone else and ruining meditation time!
: Noooo, but we didn’t even get to the dowsing yet! That was supposed to be the fun part!
: Witchcraft isn’t about fun! It’s about explaining and manipulating the unknown! Which is something you’d know if you paid attention for more than five seconds!
: Yeah, well maybe it’s just really fucking boring! Come on, Akira. Let’s get drunk and have heterosexual sex with each other. Which is a thing we definitely do!
: Are my dreams coming true or do we just need to keep deceiving them for reasons I don’t understand?
: Confuse the lesbians! Scatter!
Osako pulls me out of the classroom so quickly that I’m pretty sure she dislocates my shoulder.
